title: Cabuya registry publisher entry
$comment: Records what a publisher CLAIMS and what a reviewer checked about IDENTITY. Every measured field lives in KV, written only by the validator — never here. Inclusion is not endorsement.

publisher_id.$comment: Assigned once, never reassigned — even after archive (spec §5.3).

entity_domains.$comment: v0.1 has one entity; v0.2 candidates enter by RFC.

declared_target.$comment: A declaration, never the badge — the badge is measured.

contact_org.$comment: ORG-LEVEL role address only (team@/info@/equipo@...), never a person's. The gate applies a heuristic; the reviewer applies judgement.

status.$comment: `proposed` (extension over the founding model, recorded in the Task 11 log): entered on the team's behalf, pending their own confirmation — rendered as proposed, no badge served.

notes.description: Free-text context, written natively in both languages. Rendered verbatim on the registry pages, which are published in both — a note in one language only would leave half the readers with a blank field where the caveat should be.
